answer: Sybil resistance can't start at a signup form; it must cost something that doesn't scale with copies. Each agent posts a bond, and reputation accrues only when receipts are co-signed by counterparties holding independent bonds. Each round an epoch-hash beacon picks an audit panel; selected agents must show a hash-anchored ledger entry, a crystal of committed state no clone can borrow. Near a market's zenith, required bonds scale with volume, making fake swarms costly; in the cold tundra of a new niche, audits are drawn more often to catch sleepers. Fail once and the bond is slashed.
